text: "Admission Application Form for International Students of Xi 'an Jiaotong University" (completed in the online application system of the International Education College of Xi 'an Jiaotong University)A notarized copy of the high school diploma. For texts other than Chinese or English, an official translation notarized copy is required. Fresh graduates should provide the original pre-graduation certificate issued by their current school and supplement the official documents when reporting for enrollment.Academic transcript. Notarized copies of the transcripts of all courses in high school and the explanation of the school's academic performance evaluation system. For texts other than Chinese or English, official translation notarized copies are required. The score report of a unified standardized test in the student's country or an internationally recognized standardized test (such as Atevel, IBDP, etc.)Proof of language proficiency (such as IELTS, TOEFL, Duolingo, HSK certificates, etc. 2. Native speakers of Chinese/English are not required to provide after being recognized by our school).Five recommendation letters. One letter, issued by the high school principal or teacher (signed by the recommender and indicating the email address and contact number); Study plan. Write in Chinese or English, no less than 600 words; Since the Ordinary valid foreign passport; the foreigners physical check form the original and notarized (this table shall be uniformly printed by the Chinese health and quarantine departments and can click http://sie.xitu.edu.cn/en/2.pdf to download, should be completed in English or Chinese. Applicants should strictly conduct the inspection in accordance with the items required in the table. Forms with missing items, without the applicant's photo attached or without a cross-stitch seal on the photo, and without the doctor's opinion and the hospital's signature and seal are invalid. The validity period of the inspection results is six months. A certificate of no criminal record within the validity period; A certificate of no criminal record within the validity period;Other supporting materials (if any).Note: a.
